segments.name: Privacy technology
segments.description: A privacy technology company implementing a digital asset treasury strategy anchored by Zcash, while its subsidiary Leap develops antibody therapies for cancer patients.
segments.evidence: We are a privacy technology company implementing a digital asset treasury strategy anchored by Zcash and, through our subsidiary Leap, are developing novel therapies for patients with cancer.

changes.text: In 2025, the company changed its name from Leap Therapeutics, Inc. to Cypherpunk Technologies Inc. and shifted its strategic focus to a Zcash digital asset treasury strategy.
changes.evidence: On November 12, 2025, we changed our name from "Leap Therapeutics, Inc." to "Cypherpunk Technologies Inc." and changed our trading symbol from "LPTX" to "CYPH".
